text: How come you let the visa expire on 8 February - had you applied for a renewal appointment three months before the expiry date? In any case, your husband is still in the bituach leumi grace period - he has 45 days from the date of that letter before his entitlement to health and social security is cancelled. You can read about it on our website here: https://aic.org.il/bituach-leumi-qualification-after-expiry-of-visa/
